# Minutes of the institute committee, 12 May 2025

Present: Jon Pike (chair), Maria Lopez (Finance Office), Aiko Tanaka, Samuel Osei.

1. Budget. Maria Lopez presented the grants budget for 2025-26. The Aldmoor peat project is 18,000 euros over its equipment line; she asked the project lead to explain the overrun by the next meeting.

2. Reporting. Every project lead must submit a data management plan by 30 June 2025. Projects without a plan will not receive second-year funding.

3. Flume. Aiko Tanaka reported that the flume pump vibrates at high flow rates. Samuel Osei will measure the vibration before any experiment runs above 60 litres per second.

Jon Pike closed the meeting at 16:40.
